map.冲突检测按（时间片 + 教师）与（时间片 + 教室）两个维度建索引：同一时间片内: Conflict detection indexes on two dimensions — (time slot + teacher) and (time slot + room): the same teacher appearing twice in one slot is a teacher conflict, the same room twice in one slot is a room conflict; conflict count = teacher conflicts + room conflicts; conflict-free rate = conflict-free slots ÷ total slots × 100%; the visual timetable grids courses by week × period and highlights conflicting cells for easy adjustment.
map.📚 深度解析：课程表冲突检测: Deep Dive: Class Schedule Conflict Detector
map.排课前预检：把拟排课程（星期、节次、教师、教室）粘贴进工具，自动两两比对时间重叠: Pre-check before scheduling: paste the planned courses (weekday, period, teacher, room) into the tool; it automatically compares overlaps pairwise and flags teacher conflicts (same teacher, same time, two courses) and room conflicts (same room, same time, two courses).
map.教室资源优化：通过教室冲突提示，发现同一教室被重复占用，及时调整或申请扩容，避免: Room resource optimization: room-conflict hints reveal a room double-booked, so you can adjust in time or request expansion, avoiding class “collisions”.
map.教师工作量核查：教师冲突往往意味着排课对人手估算不足，提示需增派教师或错峰排课。: Teacher workload check: teacher conflicts usually mean the schedule underestimates staffing, hinting that more teachers are needed or classes should be staggered.
map.课程A 周一1-2节 教师张三 教室101；课程B 周一1-2节 教师张三 教室: Course A: Monday 1-2, Teacher Zhang, Room 101; Course B: Monday 1-2, Teacher Zhang, Room 102; Course C: Monday 1-2, Teacher Li, Room 101. A and B overlap in time and share a teacher → 1 teacher conflict, different rooms so no room conflict; A and C overlap in time and share Room 101 → 1 room conflict, different teachers so no teacher conflict; total: 3 courses, 1 teacher conflict, 1 room conflict.
map.冲突判定依据是什么？: What is the basis for conflict detection?
map.两门课若「星期相同」且节次区间交叉（a.start≤b.end 且 b.star: Two courses conflict if they share the same weekday and their period ranges overlap (a.start≤b.end and b.start≤a.end; periods are discrete whole periods, sharing one period counts as overlap); on top of the overlap, compare whether teacher/room are the same, recording teacher or room conflicts separately. The tool only does time + resource conflict detection, not course reasonableness.
map.能检测跨周或单双周冲突吗？: Can it detect cross-week or odd/even-week conflicts?
map.当前按固定星期+节次比对，未区分单双周/隔周课；若课程含单双周安排，需把冲突周次: Currently it compares by fixed weekday + period, without distinguishing odd/even weeks or alternating weeks; if a course has odd/even-week scheduling, list the conflicting weeks separately before comparing, or mark the week in the input to avoid missed detection. Results are for initial scheduling checks only.
map.课程表冲突检测是一款教育学习领域的在线工具。: Class Schedule Conflict Detector is an online tool in the education and learning domain.
map.课程名,教师,教室,星期,起始节,结束节\n例如：\n高等数学,张老师,A101: Course,Teacher,Room,Weekday,Start,End example: Advanced Math,Teacher Zhang,A101,1,1,2 Linear Algebra,Teacher Zhang,B202,1,1,2 English,Teacher Li,A101,1,3,4
map.每行一条：课程名,教师,教室,星期(1-7),起始节次,结束节次（节次 1–20: One course per line: course, teacher, room, weekday (1-7), start period, end period (1-20) [, class [, start week [, end week [, parity (all/odd/even)]]]]; weeks 1-30; if class/weeks are omitted, class is not checked and all weeks are assumed.
map.按（星期 + 节次 + 周次）判断两门课是否真的同时发生，再分别检测同一教师、同: Conflicts are judged by weekday + period + week: first check whether two courses truly coincide, then detect repeated occupancy of the same teacher, room, or class; courses with different start/end weeks or odd/even parity are not falsely flagged. Metrics are now “courses in conflict” and “conflict share of occupied slots”, so empty slots no longer dilute the denominator; teacher, room, and class conflicts may overlap on the same pair. The visual grid maps weekday × period and highlights conflict cells.
map.排课前预检：每行录入「课程,教师,教室,星期,起止节次[,班级[,起始周[,结束: Pre-scheduling check: enter “course, teacher, room, weekday, start-end periods [, class [, start week [, end week [, parity]]]]” per line; first check whether two courses truly coincide by weekday + period + week, then detect repeated occupancy of the same teacher, room or class. Courses with different week ranges or odd/even parity are not falsely flagged.
map.冲突指标不稀释：输出课程总数、冲突课程数、班级/教师/教室冲突数与“占用时段冲突: Undiluted conflict metrics: output total courses, courses in conflict, class/teacher/room conflicts, and “conflict share of occupied slots” (conflict slots ÷ actually occupied slots). The denominator is no longer 7×max period, so a sparse timetable is not diluted by empty slots.
map.算例：同班两课周次不重叠 vs 重叠: Example: same class, non-overlapping vs overlapping weeks
map.课程A：周一1-2节、班级一班、第1-8周；课程B：同一时间、班级一班、第9-1: Course A: Monday periods 1-2, Class 1, weeks 1-8; Course B: same time, Class 1, weeks 9-16 → no week overlap, so no class conflict. If B is changed to weeks 5-12, the common weeks are 5-8 and one class conflict is reported. If A and B share a teacher but are odd/even weeks over the same range, there is no common week and no teacher conflict.
map.能。输入可选填班级、起始周、结束周与单双周（全/单/双）；工具先求两课周次交集（: Yes. Input may optionally include class, start week, end week and parity (all/odd/even); the tool intersects the week ranges (overlap of start/end, then filters by parity) and only reports a conflict when a common week and weekday/period overlap exist. Omitted weeks mean all weeks 1–30; omitted class means the class dimension is not checked.
